description: This source file is a shell script for testing Git rebase functionalities, particularly focusing on rebase with merge commits, rebase-inteactive operations, and related behaviors. It contains setup routines, test cases, and assertions used in automated testing of Git's rebase features.

methods.name: test_cmp_graph
methods.description: Compares the current Git graph with the expected output, supporting boundary and format options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that should succeed, executing the given shell commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Validates that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a given path does not exist.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks that a given path is a file.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes lines to a file for testing.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output content.

methods.name: test_set_sequence_editor
methods.description: Configures sequence editor for the test environment.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Writes a shell script to a file.

methods.name: check_reworded_commits
methods.description: Verifies that commits have been correctly reworded during rebase.
